content.description: Two clutch hubs (No. 2 and No. 1) shown in cross-section view, with front arrow indicator

items.title: INSERT NO. 1 AND NO. 2 CLUTCH HUB INTO HUB SLEEVE

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Install the clutch hub and shifting keys to the hub sleeve.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Install the shifting key springs under the shifting keys.

content.text: Install the key springs positioned so that their end gaps are not in line.

content.description: Hand installing synchronizer and gear onto shaft, showing alignment of ring slots with shifting keys

items.title: INSTALL THIRD GEAR AND NO. 2 CLUTCH HUB ON OUTPUT SHAFT

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Apply gear oil to the shaft.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Place the synchronizer ring on the gear and align the ring slots with the shifting keys.

content.description: Exploded view of output shaft assembly showing third gear and No. 2 clutch hub components stacked vertically

items.label: (c)
items.text: Using a press, install the 3rd gear and No. 2 clutch hub.

content.description: Hands installing snap ring onto shaft, showing ring installation from both sides

items.title: INSTALL SNAP RING
items.text: Select a snap ring that will allow minimum axial play, and install it on the shaft.

content.description: Hands using feeler gauge to measure third gear thrust clearance

items.title: MEASURE THIRD GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE
items.text: Using a feeler gauge, measure the 3rd gear thrust clearance.
